claims.text: AFFIRMATIVE EVIDENCE AGAINST THE ACCOUNT, NOT MERELY AN ABSENCE. Klass records: 'Stone claims that he and his Army team were sent to the USAF Bentwaters base in England in late December of 1980 to investigate a UFO incident... A further challenge to this claim is that on Dec. 23, 1983, Stone made a Freedom Of Information Act (FOIA) request to the USAF for information on the Bentwaters UFO incident which he would have acquired during his (alleged) official visit in 1980. Further, Stone's request used his home address and did not show that he was an Army sergeant.' This is an act by Stone, three years after the event, inconsistent with his own later account of having been there officially.
